blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握器材 BET 的前置條件：設備校驗、去熱原處理、分析師訓練
blocks.en: Master the prerequisites for device BET: equipment calibration, depyrogenation, and analyst training

blocks.zh: 理解 Continued Suitability（持續適用性）的觸發條件與管理邏輯
blocks.en: Understand the triggers and management logic of continued suitability

blocks.zh: 學會解讀器材 BET 結果：合格判定、不合格調查流程
blocks.en: Learn to interpret device BET results: acceptance decisions and the investigation process for failures

blocks.zh: 了解 RPT（兔熱原試驗）在器材測試中的角色 — 何時使用 ⟨151⟩
blocks.en: Understand the role of the RPT (rabbit pyrogen test) in device testing, and when to use ⟨151⟩

blocks.zh: 掌握 ⟨85⟩、⟨151⟩、⟨161⟩ 三者的完整關係與適用情境
blocks.en: Master the complete relationship among ⟨85⟩, ⟨151⟩, and ⟨161⟩ and the situations where each applies

blocks.zh: 理解 CDMO 組合產品（PFS / autoinjector）的 BET 合規策略
blocks.en: Understand the BET compliance strategy for CDMO combination products (PFS / autoinjector)

blocks.zh: Prerequisites to Testing — 測試前置條件
blocks.en: Prerequisites to Testing

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 前置條件清單
blocks.en: Core Concept: Checklist of Prerequisites

blocks.zh: USP ⟨161⟩ 在這裡強調的是「你準備好測試了嗎？」，包含三大支柱：
blocks.en: What USP ⟨161⟩ stresses here is "are you ready to test?", which rests on three pillars:

blocks.zh: 設備合格（Equipment Qualification）：水浴、加熱塊、微量移液器、讀板機 — 都需要校驗和確效
blocks.en: Equipment qualification: water baths, heating blocks, micropipettes, and plate readers all require calibration and validation

blocks.zh: 耗材去熱原（Depyrogenation）：玻璃器皿必須經過乾熱滅菌（通常 250°C / 30 min 或 180°C / 3 hr），塑膠耗材必須證明無可檢測內毒素
blocks.en: Depyrogenation of consumables: glassware must be depyrogenated by dry heat (typically 250°C / 30 min or 180°C / 3 hr), and plastic consumables must be shown to be free of detectable endotoxin

blocks.zh: 人員訓練（Analyst Training）：操作員必須經過適當的訓練 — 包括操作技巧和結果判讀
blocks.en: Analyst training: operators must be properly trained, in both technique and interpretation of results

blocks.zh: 這些看似基本，但在稽查中經常是觀察缺失（observation）的來源。
blocks.en: These look basic, but they are often a source of observations in inspections.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 廚師上菜前的準備：
blocks.en: A chef preparing before service:

blocks.zh: 就像一位專業廚師在烹飪前必須：確認爐火溫度正確（設備校驗）、確保砧板和刀具乾淨無菌（耗材去熱原）、而且廚師本人受過正規訓練（人員資格）。如果砧板上有上一道菜的殘留（內毒素汙染），無論你的食材多好，最終的菜品都會出問題。
blocks.en: Just as a professional chef must, before cooking, confirm the stove temperature is right (equipment calibration), make sure the cutting board and knives are clean and sterile (depyrogenation of consumables), and have had formal training (personnel qualification). If the cutting board carries residue from the previous dish (endotoxin contamination), the final dish will have problems no matter how good the ingredients are.

blocks.zh: BET 測試也是一樣 — 任何前置步驟出問題，結果都不可信。
blocks.en: BET works the same way: if any prerequisite step is wrong, the result cannot be trusted.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 試劑批次變更
blocks.en: Key Point: Reagent Lot Changes

blocks.zh: 每次換 LAL 試劑或 CSE/RSE 標準品的新批號，都必須重新確認試驗靈敏度。這不是「建議」，而是 USP 的強制要求。
blocks.en: Every time you change to a new lot of LAL reagent or CSE/RSE standard, the test sensitivity must be reconfirmed. This is not a "recommendation"; it is a mandatory USP requirement.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，這意味著你的 QC 實驗室需要維護一份完整的試劑批次追溯記錄，每次新開試劑都要有靈敏度確認的紀錄。常見的稽查問題：
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, this means your QC laboratory needs to maintain a complete reagent lot traceability record, with a sensitivity confirmation record every time a new reagent is opened. Common audit findings:

blocks.zh: 試劑開封日期 vs 使用期限的管理
blocks.en: Managing the date a reagent is opened versus its expiry

blocks.zh: 新舊批號切換時的過渡驗證
blocks.en: Bridging validation when switching between old and new lots

blocks.zh: 標準曲線的 r² 值是否持續符合 ≥ 0.980 的要求
blocks.en: Whether the r² of the standard curve consistently meets the requirement of ≥ 0.980

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的 QC 實驗室新進了一批 LAL 試劑（不同供應商），請列出在開始常規測試前必須完成的所有前置步驟。
blocks.en: Your QC laboratory has received a new lot of LAL reagent (from a different supplier). List all the prerequisite steps that must be completed before routine testing starts.

blocks.zh: 一位新進分析師要開始獨立執行器材 BET 測試。從訓練到放行獨立操作，你的 SOP 應該包含哪些資格確認步驟？
blocks.en: A new analyst is about to start performing device BET independently. From training to release for independent work, which qualification steps should your SOP include?

blocks.zh: Demonstration of Continued Suitability — 持續適用性驗證
blocks.en: Demonstration of Continued Suitability

blocks.zh: 駕照與車型變更：
blocks.en: A driver's license and a change of vehicle:

blocks.zh: 你拿到駕照後（通過適用性測試），只要你開的是同一類車、走同一條路，駕照一直有效。但如果你換了一款完全不同的車（變更萃取方法），或者要開到不同國家（換測試地點），你可能需要重新考試。
blocks.en: Once you have your license (you passed the suitability test), it stays valid as long as you drive the same class of vehicle on the same road. But if you switch to a completely different vehicle (change of extraction method) or drive in a different country (change of testing site), you may have to take the test again.

blocks.zh: 同樣地，器材 BET 的適用性驗證不是「一次性」工作。任何可能影響測試準確性的變更，都需要重新評估。
blocks.en: In the same way, demonstrating suitability for device BET is not a one-time job. Any change that could affect the accuracy of the test requires re-evaluation.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 常規測試的關鍵限制
blocks.en: Key Point: A Key Restriction on Routine Testing

blocks.zh: 常規測試必須使用與適用性研究完全相同的萃取技術。這是一個經常被忽略但在稽查中很容易被抓到的問題。
blocks.en: Routine testing must use exactly the same extraction technique as the suitability study. This is often overlooked, yet it is easily caught in inspections.

blocks.zh: 實務中常見的違規：
blocks.en: Common violations in practice:

blocks.zh: 適用性研究用浸泡法，常規測試改用沖洗法（因為更方便）
blocks.en: The suitability study used soaking, but routine testing switched to flushing (because it is more convenient)

blocks.zh: 適用性研究用 40 mL 萃取液，常規測試改用 20 mL（為了節省試劑）
blocks.en: The suitability study used 40 mL of extract, but routine testing uses 20 mL (to save reagent)

blocks.zh: 適用性研究在 37°C 萃取，常規測試「大概」在室溫進行
blocks.en: The suitability study extracted at 37°C, but routine testing is done "roughly" at room temperature

blocks.zh: 任何偏離都需要重新做適用性驗證。沒有捷徑。
blocks.en: Any deviation requires the suitability demonstration to be repeated. There are no shortcuts.

blocks.zh: 情境題：你的 CDMO 工廠原本使用凝膠法（gel-clot）進行器材 BET，現在計劃升級為動力學顯色法（kinetic chromogenic）以提高通量。除了方法驗證之外，你還需要做什麼？
blocks.en: Scenario: your CDMO plant has been using the gel-clot method for device BET and now plans to upgrade to the kinetic chromogenic method to increase throughput. Besides method validation, what else do you need to do?

blocks.zh: 客戶通知你，他們的 PFS barrel 供應商從 A 公司換成 B 公司（同規格、同材質）。你需要重新做適用性測試嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: A customer notifies you that the supplier of their PFS barrels is changing from Company A to Company B (same specification, same material). Do you need to repeat suitability testing? Why?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 變更管理與 BET 適用性
blocks.en: Core Concept: Change Management and BET Suitability

blocks.zh: 什麼時候必須重新做適用性測試？USP ⟨161⟩ 列出了一張完整的變更觸發清單：
blocks.en: When must suitability testing be repeated? USP ⟨161⟩ lists a complete set of change triggers:

blocks.zh: Interpretation of Test Results — 結果判讀
blocks.en: Interpretation of Test Results

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 合格判定邏輯
blocks.en: Core Concept: Acceptance Decision Logic

blocks.zh: 器材 BET 結果的合格判定很直接：
blocks.en: Acceptance decisions for device BET results are straightforward:

blocks.zh: 一般器材：平均內毒素 < 20 EU/device → 合格
blocks.en: General devices: mean endotoxin < 20 EU/device → pass

blocks.zh: 腦脊液接觸器材：平均內毒素 < 2.15 EU/device → 合格
blocks.en: CSF-contacting devices: mean endotoxin < 2.15 EU/device → pass

blocks.zh: 液態醫療器材：遵循 ⟨85⟩ 中藥品的 MVD 和限值規則
blocks.en: Liquid medical devices: follow the MVD and limit rules for drug products in ⟨85⟩

blocks.zh: 關鍵限制：如果 BET 測試有效但結果不合格（failed），你不能改用兔熱原試驗（RPT / ⟨151⟩）來「重新測試」。這是為了防止「考試不及格就換一張比較容易的考卷」的投機行為。
blocks.en: Key restriction: if a BET is valid but the result fails, you may not switch to the rabbit pyrogen test (RPT / ⟨151⟩) to "retest". This prevents the opportunistic behavior of "failing an exam and switching to an easier one".

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 不能用 RPT 替代失敗的 BET
blocks.en: Analogy: You Cannot Use the RPT to Replace a Failed BET

blocks.zh: 考試補考的規則：
blocks.en: The rules for a retake exam:

blocks.zh: 想像你參加數學考試（BET），考了 55 分（不合格）。你不能說「這次數學考得不好，讓我改考體育（RPT）吧，體育比較容易過。」
blocks.en: Imagine you sit a math exam (BET) and score 55 (fail). You cannot say, "I did badly in math this time, so let me take physical education (RPT) instead, since PE is easier to pass."

blocks.zh: USP ⟨161⟩ 明確禁止這種做法。BET 不合格就是不合格 — 你必須走調查流程（OOS investigation），找出根本原因（root cause），然後決定是重新取樣、重新測試，還是拒收整批產品。
blocks.en: USP ⟨161⟩ explicitly prohibits this practice. A BET failure is a failure: you must follow the investigation process (OOS investigation), find the root cause, and then decide whether to resample, retest, or reject the whole lot.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 OOS 調查流程
blocks.en: Key Point: OOS Investigation Process

blocks.zh: 當器材 BET 結果超出限值時，CDMO 應該：
blocks.en: When a device BET result exceeds the limit, the CDMO should:

blocks.zh: Phase 1 — 實驗室調查：檢查是否有操作錯誤、試劑問題、設備故障
blocks.en: Phase 1, laboratory investigation: check for operator error, reagent problems, and equipment malfunction

blocks.zh: Phase 2 — 延伸調查：如果實驗室沒有問題，回溯製程 — 清洗程序、去熱原步驟、水系統、環境監測數據
blocks.en: Phase 2, extended investigation: if the laboratory shows no problem, trace back through the process: cleaning procedures, depyrogenation steps, the water system, and environmental monitoring data

blocks.zh: Phase 3 — 影響評估：評估同批次其他產品是否受影響，是否需要擴大調查範圍
blocks.en: Phase 3, impact assessment: assess whether other products in the same lot are affected and whether the scope of the investigation needs to be widened

blocks.zh: 不能做的事：不能把 BET 不合格的樣品改送 RPT 來「解套」。
blocks.en: What you must not do: you must not send a failed BET sample to the RPT to "get out of trouble".

blocks.zh: 你的 QC 報告顯示某批 PFS barrel 的 BET 結果為 22 EU/device（限值 20 EU/device）。請描述你的調查步驟和決策樹。
blocks.en: Your QC report shows that a lot of PFS barrels gave a BET result of 22 EU/device (limit 20 EU/device). Describe your investigation steps and decision tree.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 禁止用 RPT 來替代失敗的 BET？從科學角度（靈敏度、定量性）和法規角度（數據完整性）分別說明。
blocks.en: Why does USP prohibit using the RPT to replace a failed BET? Explain from a scientific perspective (sensitivity, quantitation) and from a regulatory perspective (data integrity).

blocks.zh: Pyrogens — 兔熱原試驗 (RPT)
blocks.en: Pyrogens: Rabbit Pyrogen Test (RPT)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 RPT 的使用時機
blocks.en: Core Concept: When to Use the RPT

blocks.zh: RPT（Rabbit Pyrogen Test，兔熱原試驗）在器材測試中是最後手段，只有在以下條件同時成立時才能使用：
blocks.en: For device testing, the RPT (rabbit pyrogen test) is the last resort and may be used only when all of the following conditions are met:

blocks.zh: BET 測試存在無法去除的干擾（inhibition 或 enhancement）
blocks.en: The BET has interference that cannot be removed (inhibition or enhancement)

blocks.zh: 嘗試過稀釋、pH 調整、葡聚醣阻斷等所有補救措施後，干擾仍然存在
blocks.en: After trying all remedies such as dilution, pH adjustment, and glucan blocking, the interference persists

blocks.zh: 因此無法對該產品執行有效的 BET
blocks.en: As a result, a valid BET cannot be performed on the product

blocks.zh: 重要區分：
blocks.en: Important distinction:

blocks.zh: BET 「做了但不合格」→ 不能改用 RPT
blocks.en: BET "performed but failed" → cannot switch to the RPT

blocks.zh: BET 「根本做不了」（干擾無法消除）→ 可以用 RPT
blocks.en: BET "cannot be performed at all" (interference cannot be eliminated) → can use the RPT

blocks.zh: 過敏體質與替代療法：
blocks.en: Allergy and alternative therapy:

blocks.zh: 想像 BET 是一種首選藥物（efficacy 最好），RPT 是替代藥物。只有當病人對首選藥物「過敏」（無法去除的干擾）時，醫生才會開替代藥物。但如果病人吃了首選藥物沒效果（BET 不合格），不能因此換成替代藥物 — 問題出在病情本身，不是藥物選擇。
blocks.en: Think of BET as the first-choice drug (the best efficacy) and the RPT as the alternative drug. Only when the patient is "allergic" to the first-choice drug (interference that cannot be removed) will the doctor prescribe the alternative. But if the patient takes the first-choice drug and it does not work (BET failure), you cannot switch to the alternative on that basis: the problem lies in the condition itself, not in the choice of drug.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 RPT 的萃取限制
blocks.en: Key Point: Extraction Restrictions for the RPT

blocks.zh: RPT 的萃取條件比 BET 更嚴格：
blocks.en: The extraction conditions for the RPT are stricter than for BET:

blocks.zh: 萃取液改用無菌生理食鹽水（不是 BET 水）— 因為要注射到兔子體內
blocks.en: The extraction fluid is changed to sterile saline (not BET water), because it will be injected into rabbits

blocks.zh: 每個器材的萃取液體積 NMT 40 mL — 受限於兔子的注射體積
blocks.en: The extract volume per device is NMT 40 mL, limited by the injection volume for rabbits

blocks.zh: 最多取 10 個器材的合併萃取液
blocks.en: Pooled extracts from up to 10 devices may be used

blocks.zh: CDMO 注意：現在 RPT 在全球製藥界已經極少使用，但 USP ⟨161⟩ 仍保留它作為 BET 無法執行時的替代方案。歐盟已傾向全面淘汰動物試驗，改用重組 Factor C（rFC）等替代方法。
blocks.en: CDMO note: the RPT is now rarely used in the pharmaceutical industry worldwide, but USP ⟨161⟩ still keeps it as an alternative when BET cannot be performed. The EU is moving toward phasing out animal testing altogether, using alternatives such as recombinant Factor C (rFC).

blocks.zh: 一款新型生物可吸收植入物，萃取液對 LAL 試劑產生強烈的增強干擾（enhancement），稀釋至 MVD 後仍無法消除。你接下來的選項有哪些？RPT 是否為合理的替代方案？
blocks.en: For a new bioresorbable implant, the extract causes strong enhancement interference with LAL reagent that cannot be eliminated even when diluted to the MVD. What are your next options? Is the RPT a reasonable alternative?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 RPT 使用無菌生理食鹽水而不是 BET 水？從動物試驗安全性的角度思考。
blocks.en: Why does the RPT use sterile saline rather than BET water? Think about it from the standpoint of animal test safety.
⟨85⟩, ⟨151⟩, ⟨161⟩: The Complete Relationship Among the Three Chapters

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 三章關係圖
blocks.en: Core Concept: Relationship Diagram of the Three Chapters

blocks.zh: ⟨85⟩ BET 方法學通則
blocks.en: ⟨85⟩ General methodology for BET

blocks.zh: ↓ 方法引用
blocks.en: ↓ method reference

blocks.zh: ⟨161⟩ 器材專用應用
blocks.en: ⟨161⟩ Device-specific application

blocks.zh: ↓ BET 無法執行時的替代
blocks.en: ↓ alternative when BET cannot be performed

blocks.zh: ⟨151⟩ 兔熱原試驗（RPT）
blocks.en: ⟨151⟩ Rabbit pyrogen test (RPT)

blocks.zh: 理解邏輯：
blocks.en: The logic:

blocks.zh: ⟨85⟩ 是基礎方法 — 所有 BET 操作都參考它
blocks.en: ⟨85⟩ is the foundation method: all BET operations refer to it

blocks.zh: ⟨161⟩ 是應用層 — 在 ⟨85⟩ 的方法基礎上，加入器材特有的限值、萃取方法和取樣規則
blocks.en: ⟨161⟩ is the application layer: on the method foundation of ⟨85⟩, it adds device-specific limits, extraction methods, and sampling rules

blocks.zh: ⟨151⟩ 是備選方案 — 僅在 BET 因干擾無法執行時使用
blocks.en: ⟨151⟩ is the fallback option: used only when BET cannot be performed because of interference

blocks.zh: 對於組合產品（combination products）如 PFS：藥液直接適用 ⟨85⟩，器材組件適用 ⟨161⟩（引用 ⟨85⟩ 方法）。
blocks.en: For combination products such as a PFS: the drug solution falls directly under ⟨85⟩, and the device components fall under ⟨161⟩ (which references the ⟨85⟩ method).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 CDMO 的「雙軌制」
blocks.en: Analogy: The CDMO "Dual Track"

blocks.zh: 高速公路與市區道路：
blocks.en: Highways and city streets:

blocks.zh: 想像 ⟨85⟩ 是一本「交通法規總則」，適用於所有道路。⟨161⟩ 則像是「高速公路專用規範」— 它引用總則的基本規則（靠右行駛、遵守速限），但加上了高速公路特有的規定（最低速限、匝道合流規則）。
blocks.en: Think of ⟨85⟩ as the "general traffic code", which applies to all roads. ⟨161⟩ is like the "highway-specific rules": it references the basic rules of the general code (keep right, obey speed limits) but adds rules specific to highways (minimum speed, on-ramp merging rules).

blocks.zh: 而 ⟨151⟩ 就像「緊急停車帶」— 只有在正常車道無法通行時才能使用。
blocks.en: And ⟨151⟩ is like the "emergency stopping lane": it may be used only when the normal lanes are impassable.

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，你的工廠同時在「兩條路」上行駛：藥品走 ⟨85⟩ 主線，器材走 ⟨161⟩ 專線。你的 QC 團隊需要熟悉兩套規則。
blocks.en: As a CDMO, your plant drives on "two roads" at once: drug products follow the ⟨85⟩ main line and devices follow the ⟨161⟩ dedicated line. Your QC team needs to be familiar with both sets of rules.

blocks.zh: 一款自動注射器（autoinjector）包含：藥液、玻璃卡管、橡膠柱塞、不銹鋼針頭、塑膠外殼。請為每個組件指定適用的 USP 章節和內毒素限值。
blocks.en: An autoinjector contains: drug solution, glass cartridge, rubber plunger, stainless steel needle, and plastic housing. For each component, specify the applicable USP chapter and endotoxin limit.

blocks.zh: 你的歐洲客戶要求不使用動物試驗（3Rs 原則）。如果某器材組件的 BET 存在無法去除的干擾，除了 RPT 之外，你還有什麼替代方案？（提示：rFC、MAT）
blocks.en: Your European customer asks for no animal testing (the 3Rs principle). If the BET for a device component has interference that cannot be removed, what alternatives do you have besides the RPT? (Hint: rFC, MAT)

blocks.zh: ANSI/AAMI ST72 在 ⟨161⟩ 的參考文獻中被引用。它涵蓋了「替代批次測試（alternatives to batch testing）」的概念。你認為在什麼條件下，可以不對每一批器材都做 BET 測試？
blocks.en: ANSI/AAMI ST72 is cited in the references of ⟨161⟩. It covers the concept of "alternatives to batch testing". Under what conditions do you think BET might not need to be performed on every lot of devices?

blocks.zh: 重點提示 CDMO 組合產品合規策略
blocks.en: Key Point: CDMO Combination Product Compliance Strategy

blocks.zh: PFS / Autoinjector 的 BET 合規矩陣：
blocks.en: BET compliance matrix for PFS / autoinjector:

blocks.zh: 策略建議：建立一份組合產品 BET 矩陣（Combination Product BET Matrix），將每個組件的適用章節、限值、萃取方法和測試頻率整合成一張文件。這在客戶審計和法規稽查中會非常有用。
blocks.en: Recommended strategy: build a combination product BET matrix that consolidates each component's applicable chapter, limit, extraction method, and test frequency into a single document. This will be very useful in customer audits and regulatory inspections.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 前置條件：設備校驗 + 耗材去熱原 + 人員訓練 + 試劑靈敏度確認 — 缺一不可
blocks.en: Prerequisites: equipment calibration + depyrogenation of consumables + analyst training + reagent sensitivity confirmation; none can be omitted

blocks.zh: 持續適用性：產品、製程、供應商、地點、試劑、方法的任何重大變更都可能觸發重新驗證
blocks.en: Continued suitability: any significant change in product, process, supplier, site, reagent, or method may trigger revalidation

blocks.zh: 萃取技術變更 = 必須重做適用性，BET 方法變更（如凝膠法改動力學法）也是
blocks.en: A change of extraction technique = suitability must be repeated, and so is a change of BET method (such as gel-clot to kinetic)

blocks.zh: 結果判讀：一般器材 < 20 EU/device，腦脊液接觸 < 2.15 EU/device
blocks.en: Interpretation of results: general devices < 20 EU/device, CSF-contacting < 2.15 EU/device

blocks.zh: BET 失敗不能用 RPT 替代 — RPT 僅用於 BET 因干擾無法執行的情況
blocks.en: A BET failure cannot be replaced by the RPT: the RPT is used only where BET cannot be performed because of interference

blocks.zh: ⟨85⟩ + ⟨151⟩ + ⟨161⟩ 三層架構：方法通則 → 器材應用 → 動物試驗備選
blocks.en: The three-layer ⟨85⟩ + ⟨151⟩ + ⟨161⟩ structure: general methodology → device application → animal test fallback

blocks.zh: CDMO 組合產品策略：建立 Combination Product BET Matrix，藥液走 ⟨85⟩，器材組件走 ⟨161⟩
blocks.en: CDMO combination product strategy: build a Combination Product BET Matrix, with the drug solution following ⟨85⟩ and device components following ⟨161⟩
